Source acquisition, static inspection, executing donor code, generating teacher outputs, training and activating a candidate are different operations, each with its own applicable authority and evidence requirements.

For the first native-digestion experiment, choose one small donor capability with inspectable source and permitted reuse. Pin identity/rights/revision, establish its behavior and independent oracle, identify reusable semantics/dependencies, build a separately identified candidate through the existing authorized development process, compare correctness/refusals/performance, integrate a real consumer and record its cutover. Native absorption, verification, runtime admission, consumer migration, donor extinction and repository retirement remain separate facts. No generic digestion runtime is inferred from one successful case.
